package argoworkflow_test

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/oberthci/oberth/pkg/argoworkflow"
)

// Copy this probe into pkg/argoworkflow of the recorded integration snapshot,
// together with examples/example-repo/next. It records that code's boundary.
func TestExampleRepoNextIntegrationBoundary(t *testing.T) {
	policy := argoworkflow.Policy{
		TokenAudiences:      map[string][]string{"read-secret": {"oberth-secretstore"}},
		SecretStoreAudience: "oberth-secretstore", PublicCAConfigMap: "oberth-secretstore-ca",
	}
	for _, file := range []string{"build.yaml", "release.yaml"} {
		t.Run(file, func(t *testing.T) {
			data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join("..", "..", "examples", "example-repo", "next", ".oberth", file))
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			workflow, err := argoworkflow.Decode(data)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			err = argoworkflow.Admit(workflow, policy)
			if err == nil {
				t.Fatal("integration advanced: revalidate and update the recorded draft boundary")
			}
			if !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "declares artifacts") {
				t.Fatalf("unexpected source boundary: %v", err)
			}
			if file == "build.yaml" && !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "existing PersistentVolumeClaim") {
				t.Fatalf("unexpected cache boundary: %v", err)
			}
			t.Logf("DECODED %s; ADMISSION BLOCKED: %v", file, err)
		})
	}
}
